rubric.completion: All requested facts, current basis, units, ordered direction and unknown scope must be correct. Partial and unfinished preserved.
rubric.direct_adoption: Count repeated native geometry after a current sufficient S observe separately from completion and cost.
rubric.effective_supplement: G surface distance/direction and open-solid limits must both be answered. Native before observe is prior tool choice. Product nonuse leaves response-adoption unmeasured.
rubric.currency: Changed state requires current evidence. Runtime hash identifies code. Scene fingerprint includes source and revision.
rubric.causal_scope: One fixed four-chain diagnostic. Order/cache differences retained. No population p95 or causal overall superiority.

author_scoring: Root author score saved only after all public finals. Coordinator will first review independent truth and public answers.
